_comment: A full cube, authored facing north; blockstates/worker_station.json turns it. The top uses the casing sheet, so its boards run the way the sides do rather than crosswise. One model for both has_job states, and one element on purpose: a block that fills its space occludes, lights and culls like any other solid block, which is what retires the holes and see-through edges the bench-and-board shape produced twice. What is in the rack is drawn by WorkerStationRenderer as lamps on the front face -- see generate_block_textures.py, which checks that this model, that renderer and the sheets still describe one block.

elements.__comment: The cabinet. Every face spans the block boundary, so every face culls.
